newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank comment moves interbank, baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank comment moves interbank, baht.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell sharply to 11.00-11.25 percent late on Tuesday from 12.50-13.00 in early dealings as a result of a central bank call on banks to cut interest rates, dealers said.
"The interbank rate declined after the central bank governor's comment on local interest rates today," one dealer at a foreign bank said.
Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Tuesday commercial banks should cut their lending and deposit interest rates to help boost the slowing economy.
